defs.def: （与动词简单过去时连用）以前

ex.s: Not long ago, my fifth-grade son Kevin asked me about the meaning of a word in a novel.
ex.t: 不久前，我上五年级的儿子凯文问我一本小说里一个词的意思。

ex.s: A study carried out by some of its researchers several years ago concluded that city trees did release isoprene.
ex.t: 几年前该机构一些研究人员开展的一项研究得出结论：城市树木确实会释放异戊二烯。

ex.s: But as Aristotle observed over 2,000 years ago, actions pushed to their extreme turn into disasters.
ex.t: 但正如亚里士多德在2000多年前观察到的，推向极端的行为会变成灾难。

ex.s: Life on city streets started to change decades ago.
ex.t: 几十年前，城市街道上的生活开始发生变化。

ex.s: Not too long ago, on a cold winter night, there was a teenager who wanted more screen time and a parent who said no.
ex.t: 不久前，在一个寒冷的冬夜，有一个想要更多屏幕时间的少年，和一位说“不行”的家长。

ex.s: He became interested in alternative treatments 20 years ago when he suffered from terrible back pain.
ex.t: 20年前，当他遭受严重背痛时，他对替代疗法产生了兴趣。

ex.s: In addition, I have an old two-volume copy of the Shorter Oxford Dictionary, picked up a few years ago in a bookshop sale for just 99 pence.
ex.t: 此外，我有一套旧的《简明牛津词典》上下两册，是几年前在书店特卖时只花99便士买到的。

ex.s: When I decided to buy a house in Europe ten years ago, I didn't think too long.
ex.t: 十年前我决定在欧洲买房时，没想太久。

ex.s: They became friends ten years ago.
ex.t: 他们十年前就成了朋友。

ex.s: Ages ago, right?
ex.t: 很久以前了吧？

ex.s: But as we’ve reshaped the world around us, dramatically reducing the cost and effort involved in obtaining calories, we still have the same brains we had thousands of years ago, and this mismatch is at the heart of why so many of us struggle to resist tempting foods that we know we shouldn’t eat.
ex.t: 但当我们重新塑造周围的世界,大幅降低获取卡路里所需的成本和努力时,我们仍然有我们几千年前拥有的同样的大脑,这种不匹配现象正是我们许多人努力抵制诱人的食物的核心,而我们知道我们不应该吃这些食物。

ex.s: Much in the same manner, we may over the years recite to ourselves poems learnt by heart long ago, which have become part of our self-recognition.
ex.t: 同样地，我们多年来可能会背诵那些很久以前就烂熟于心的诗歌，它们已经成为我们自我认知的一部分。

ex.s: About a decade ago, I noticed that she began to lose her hearing.
ex.t: 大约十年前，我注意到她开始丧失听力。

ex.s: These scenes may have been painted hundreds of years ago, but they record moments we can all relate to.
ex.t: 这些场景也许是数百年前画下的，但它们记录了我们每个人都能感同身受的时刻。

ex.s: Many years ago, I bought a house in the Garfagnana, where we still go every summer.
ex.t: 多年前，我在加尔法尼亚纳买了一栋房子，现在每年夏天我们还去那里。

ex.s: I experienced this when I started switching to a zero waste lifestyle five years ago, as I was living with my parents, and I continue to experience this with my husband, as he is not completely zero waste like me.
ex.t: 五年前我刚开始转向零废弃生活方式时就有这种体会，那时我和父母同住；现在和丈夫在一起也继续有这种体会，因为他不像我那样完全零废弃。

ex.s: More than 30 years ago, the scholar Charles Hockett noted that speech sounds called labiodentals, such as “f” and “v”, were more common in the languages of societies that ate softer foods.
ex.t: 30多年前,学者查尔斯·霍克特(Charles Hockett)指出,在食用软食的社会语言中,称为labiodentals的语音,如“f”和“v”更为常见。

ex.s: This research overturns the popular view that all human speech sounds were present when human beings evolved around 300,000 years ago. ”The set of speech sounds we use has not necessarily remained stable since the appearance of human beings, but rather the huge variety of speech sounds that we find today is the product of a complex interplay of things like biological change and cultural evolution,“ said Steven Moran, a member of the research team.
ex.t: 这项研究推翻了“人类约30万年前进化时所有语音都已存在”的流行观点。“我们使用的语音集合自人类出现以来未必保持稳定，我们今天发现的极其多样的语音，是生物变化和文化演变等事物复杂相互作用的产物，”研究团队成员史蒂文·莫兰说。

ex.s: Although my kindergarten experience feels like a century ago, the lessons I learned will stick in my mind forever.
ex.t: 虽然我的幼儿园经历感觉像是一个世纪前的事，但我学到的教训将永远留在脑海里。

ex.s: As someone noted in this paper a couple of weeks ago, they eat great food and never gain weight.
ex.t: 正如几周前本报刊登的一位读者所指出的，他们吃美食却从不发胖。

ex.s: Bonds, who bought his first cattle almost 50 years ago, still has each of his cowboys inspect 300 or 400 cattle daily and look for signs that an animal is getting sick.
ex.t: 邦德在近50年前购买了他的第一头牛，他仍然让每个牛仔每天检查300或400头牛，并寻找动物生病的迹象。

ex.s: “I was a local here 20 years ago,” I told him.
ex.t: 我20年前是这里本地人，我告诉他。

ex.s: A couple of years ago, film-maker David Bond realised that his children, then aged five and three, were attached to screens to the point where he was able to say "chocolate" into his three-year-old son’s ear without getting a response.
ex.t: 影片制作人大卫·邦德(David Bond)在几年前意识到,他的孩子当时五岁三岁,被贴在屏幕上,以至于他可以在三岁的儿子的耳朵里说"巧克力"而没有得到回应。

ex.s: Today his hobby has developed into the website postcrossing.com, a social network that has grown to 575,217 registered users in 214 countries and regions since he started it 10 years ago.
ex.t: 如今，他的爱好已发展成一个网站 postcrossing.com——一个社交网络，自他十年前创建以来，已发展到214个国家和地区的575,217名注册用户。

ex.s: The destruction started three months ago.
ex.t: 破坏从三个月前开始。

ex.s: Three days ago, the light in our living room suddenly went out.
ex.t: 三天前客厅的灯突然灭了。

ex.s: Not very long ago, it was also unthinkable that a virus would shut down nations and that safety nets would be proven so disastrously lacking in flexibility.
ex.t: 就在不久前，一场病毒会让各国停摆、而社会保障网会被证明如此缺乏灵活性也同样是难以想象的。

ex.s: Four years ago they all moved into a three-storey Victorian house in Bristol — one of a growing number of multigenerational families in the UK living together under the same roof.
ex.t: 四年前，他们全都搬进了布里斯托尔一栋三层维多利亚式住宅——这是英国越来越多几代人同堂、住在同一屋檐下的家庭之一。

ex.s: We are the products of evolution, and not just evolution that occurred billions of years ago.
ex.t: 我们是进化的产物，而且不仅仅是数十亿年前发生的进化。

ex.s: Housewarming parties get their name from the fact that a long time ago people would actually bring firewood to a new home as a gift.
ex.t: 暖房派对得名于这样一个事实：很久以前，人们会真的带木柴作为礼物送进新家。

ex.s: Reading history is an amazing experience because it enables us to reflect on the social and economic life of the people living long time ago.
ex.t: 读史是一种奇妙的体验，因为它让我们得以反思很久以前人们的社会与经济生活。

ex.s: People living long time ago knew more about how to solve problems.
ex.t: 很久以前的人更懂得如何解决问题。

ex.s: The Neanderthals   9  （live）alongside human ancestors in Europe for tens of thousands of years, before dying out about 40, 000 years ago.
ex.t: 他们比现代人强壮得多，但长期以来人们一直假设人类祖先比尼安德特人更______。（    ）

ex.s: A bout one year ago, he got this new piece of tech which is like a test tube.
ex.t: 大约一年前，他得到了这个像试管一样的新科技产品。

ex.s: A son of immigrants, Chris stared learning English a little over three years ago.
ex.t: 作为移民的儿子，克里斯在三年多一点前才开始学习英语。

ex.s: Jenn Berman, author of The A to Z Guide to Raising Happy and Confident Kids, says, "We've gone to the opposite extreme of a few decades ago when parents tended to be more strict." By giving kids a lot of praise, parents think they're building their children's confidence, when, in fact, it may be just the opposite.
ex.t: 《培养快乐自信孩子A到Z指南》的作者Jenn Berman说："我们已经走到了几十年前父母往往更严厉的那个极端的对立面。"通过给孩子很多表扬，父母以为在建立孩子的自信，而实际上可能适得其反。

ex.s: Some language experts believe that 10,000 years ago, when the world had just five to ten million people, they spoke perhaps 12,000 languages between them.
ex.t: 一些语言专家认为，一万年前，当世界只有五百到一千万人时，他们之间可能讲着一万两千种语言。

ex.s: I learned this lesson from a（n）（2）     many years ago． I took the head（3）     job at a school in Baxley， Georgia． It was a small school with a weak football program．
ex.t: 多年前我从一个（2）___学到了这一课。我在佐治亚州巴克斯特的一所学校担任主（3）___的工作。那是一所橄榄球项目薄弱的小学校。

ex.s: Thirty years later， a woman approached me in a public place． "Excuse me， did you ever enter a residence， long ago， thinking it was the McNay Museum？"
ex.t: 三十年后，一位女士在公共场所走近我。“打扰一下，你很久以前是否曾进过一户住宅，以为那是麦克奈博物馆？”

ex.s: Many of the Chinese words that are now part of English were borrowed long ago.
ex.t: 许多现在已成为英语一部分的中文词汇是很久以前借入的。

ex.s: A century ago, when life expectancy was lower and college education less prevalent, “the goal back then was survival, not violin lessons by 5,” Twenge said.
ex.t: 一个世纪前，当预期寿命更低、大学教育不那么普及时，“那时的目标是生存，而非5岁学小提琴，”特温格说。

ex.s: Not so long ago, money was almost always created and used locally, and bartering was common.
ex.t: 不久以前，货币几乎总是在当地创造和使用，物物交换很普遍。

ex.s: If anyone had told me three years ago that I would be spending most of my weekends camping.
ex.t: 如果三年前有人告诉我，我会把大部分周末花在露营上。

ex.s: I last saw him a few months ago.
ex.t: 我上次见他是几个月前。

ex.s: decision five years ago to create a separate set of standards for light sport aircraft, which are lower than those pilots of larger planes.
ex.t: 五年前做出的为轻型运动飞机制定一套单独标准的决定，这些标准低于大型飞机飞行员所需的标准。

ex.s: Three years ago, schools in Edina, Minnesota, changed the start time from 7:25 am to 8:30 am.
ex.t: 三年前,明尼苏达州Edina的学校将开学时间从早上7点25分改为早上8点30分.

ex.s: I last saw him a few months ago.
ex.t: 我上次见他是几个月前。

ex.s: Mann said Terrafugia was helped by the Federal Aviation  Administration’s decision five years ago to create a separate set of standards for light sport aircraft, which are lower than those pilots of larger planes Terrafugia says an owner would need to pass a test and complete 20 hours of flying time to be able to fly the Transition, a requirement pilots would find relatively easy to meet.
ex.t: 曼说，Terrafugia得益于联邦航空管理局五年前做出的为轻型运动飞机制定一套单独标准的决定，这些标准低于大型飞机飞行员所需的标准。Terrafugia表示，车主需要通过一项测试并完成20小时的飞行时间才能驾驶Transition，飞行员会觉得这是很容易满足的要求。

ex.s: A century ago, the resource in question was oil.
ex.t: 一个世纪前，所讨论的资源是石油。

ex.s: In fact, we stayed at the same campsite as we did ten years ago.
ex.t: 事实上，我们和十年前一样住在同一个营地。

ex.s: Penny 1 What did Penny's dad look like ten years ago?
ex.t: Penny 1十年前Penny的爸爸长什么样？

ex.s: It was my mother's birthday ten years ago, and I decided to surprise her with home-made scrambled eggs.
ex.t: 那是十年前妈妈过生日的时候，我决定做一份自制炒鸡蛋给她一个惊喜。

ex.s: This was how things worked not very long ago.
ex.t: 不久前，事情就是这样运作的。

ex.s: They have a chat and the man starts to tell his story.“Twenty years ago tonight,” said the man, “I dined here at ‘Big Joe’ Brady’s with Jimmy Wells, my best chum, and the finest chap in the world.
ex.t: 他们聊天，男人开始讲述他的故事。“二十年前的今晚，”那人说， “我在‘大乔‘布雷迪餐厅和吉米·威尔斯一起吃饭，他是我最好的朋友，也是世界上最好的家伙。
